ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 85-90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in scars and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-spectrum contiguous area across both lobes. High-contrast white pixel segments are mapped in linear patterns across the mid-lobes and as dense, irregular blobs on the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped median notch with a pixel-defined angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography with frequent, non-uniform serrations and small-scale notches along the entire linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the peduncle towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel formations (barnacles/scars) concentrated heavily on the left and right distal tips and trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, high-contrast white linear pixel paths, primarily oriented diagonally, crossing the dark pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear rake marks across the ventral surface and extensive barnacle colonization on the trailing edge margins.
